text:
The 2026 MLS Cup playoffs have only just begun, but the league is already finalizing another change to its postseason format.
Beginning with the 2027-28 season, MLS will eliminate its short-lived wild card round to condense the playoff field to 16 teams and also get rid of the best-of-three format for the first round, sources confirmed to the Guardian after an earlier report by The Athletic.
In the new format, the first two rounds will operate as two-leg, home-and-home series, while the semi-finals and final will be one-game matchups. The higher seed will host these final single-elimination rounds, and it’s unknown how the two-leg ties will be assigned. The most recent format which utilized two-leg ties stationed the second leg at the home of the higher seed.
An MLS spokesperson did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
As one of the most undeniably “American” aspects of MLS, the playoffs have been near-continually modified as the league has grown. The current format, which has opened with a best-of-three first round since 2023, has proven ineffective at sustaining momentum and rewarding the best performers in the regular season. The past three seasons saw 35 days pass between the regular season’s end and the postseason’s second round, as it held the first round before the November international window. The league’s break during the 2026 World Cup allowed it to delay the postseason’s start to after the window, shortening that gap from Decision Day to the quarterfinal stage to 28 days.
In August, the Guardian reported on another format which was under consideration by the league. This model would have taken cues from Australian rules football, utilizing a play-in round for lower-seeded qualifiers and a double-elimination process to give the regular season’s top performers a competitive advantage.
“Major League Soccer is continuing to evaluate potential adjustments to its postseason format as part of a broader review of the league’s shift to a new competition calendar, beginning with the 2027-28 season,” a league spokesperson said at the time.
A key driver of these frequent alterations is a desire to increase the intensity of the league’s regular season. The current format is incredibly forgiving to teams, allowing 60% of clubs into the postseason. This year, Real Salt Lake made the first round despite a putrid post-World Cup run that saw the team win once from 16 games. They qualified on Decision Day over Minnesota United, who themselves had endured a stretch with one win from 18 games.
This new approach will be the sixth postseason format MLS has operated with since launching in 1996. The league briefly did away with multi-leg series beginning in 2019, only reincorporating them after launching their broadcast partnership with Apple. Justifications of that format included a talking point that owners of low-ranked qualifiers could still be guaranteed at least one match of postseason revenue.
digest_he:
החל מעונת 2027-28, ליגת ה-MLS תערוך שינוי משמעותי במבנה הפלייאוף שלה. הליגה תבטל את סיבוב הווילד קארד הקצר ותצמצם את מספר המשתתפות בפלייאוף ל-16 קבוצות. בנוסף, יבוטל פורמט הטוב משלושה משחקים שהונהג בסיבוב הראשון.

על פי המתווה החדש, שני הסיבובים הראשונים ישחקו במתכונת של משחקי בית וחוץ כפולים, בעוד ששלב חצי הגמר ומשחק הגמר המרכזי יהיו במתכונת של משחק יחיד ומכריע שיארחו הקבוצות המדורגות גבוה יותר. שינויים אלו מגיעים לאחר שנים של התאמות מבניות שנועדו להגביר את התחרותיות בעונה הסדירה ולמנוע פערים זמנים ארוכים בין סיום העונה הסדירה לשלב הפלייאוף.
